related.title: ICU CLDR：地區格式與語言回退
related.titleEn: ICU CLDR: locale formatting and language fallback
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付grapheme-fixtures.json及刪除邊界；不將內建len冒稱完整字素分析器。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver grapheme-fixtures.json and deletion boundaries; built-in len is not a grapheme segmenter. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 保存原數值與ISO貨幣代碼，再用locale顯示；建立zh-Hant-TW→zh-Hant→default回退的顯式政策。
related.differenceEn: Store numeric values and ISO currency codes, then format by locale; define an explicit zh-Hant-TW→zh-Hant→default fallback policy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
延伸字素叢集是文字編輯的一種近似使用者字元邊界；emoji序列可跨多碼點，不能用單一碼點切片當通用游標步進。
本課數值核對：4+3 = 7 code_points；另一項核對：4*4+3*3 = 25 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

locale同時含語言及地區偏好；格式化字串不應再當無地區資訊的數值解析。回退鏈須可見且可由使用者覆寫。
本課數值核對：10.5+20+30.25 = 60.75 currency_units；另一項核對：1234.5*100 = 123450 minor_units。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Extended grapheme clusters approximate user-facing editing boundaries; emoji sequences can span code points, so one-code-point slicing is not a universal cursor step.
Numeric audit: 4+3 = 7 code_points; second audit: 4*4+3*3 = 25 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

A locale combines language and regional conventions; formatted strings should not be parsed without locale context. Fallback chains should be visible and user-overridable.
Numeric audit: 10.5+20+30.25 = 60.75 currency_units; second audit: 1234.5*100 = 123450 minor_units. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SQLite：外鍵、孤兒列與匯入順序
related.titleEn: SQLite: foreign keys, orphans and import order
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付grapheme-fixtures.json及刪除邊界；不將內建len冒稱完整字素分析器。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。

related.difference: 對學員與選課資料建立外鍵，驗證匯入失敗可以回復整批。
related.differenceEn: Create student/enrolment foreign keys and verify batch import rollback.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
延伸字素叢集是文字編輯的一種近似使用者字元邊界；emoji序列可跨多碼點，不能用單一碼點切片當通用游標步進。

參照完整性約束的是子鍵是否有父鍵；SQLite 連線必須明確開啟並確認 foreign_keys。 教學基準：5-1 = 4 valid child rows；第二檢核：1/5*100 = 20 orphan percent。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Extended grapheme clusters approximate user-facing editing boundaries; emoji sequences can span code points, so one-code-point slicing is not a universal cursor step.
Numeric audit: 4+3 = 7 code_points; second audit: 4*4+3*3 = 25 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Referential integrity checks child keys against parent keys; explicitly enable and verify SQLite foreign_keys per connection. Teaching baseline: 5-1 = 4 valid child rows; second check: 1/5*100 = 20 orphan percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
